report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency issues, but current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.0012, p95 76ms, no dependency timeouts or pool waiters, INFO 200 logs. Only one ERROR trace shows a 1951ms gateway->inventory call. No inventory/order/payment telemetry is available, so no bounded root cause can be established.
missing_evidence: Inventory service traces/metrics/logs for the same window to explain the 1951ms ERROR span
Order and payment service telemetry to localize the checkout path failure
Postgresql pool and latency metrics for order
Alert source and time window confirming the reported error-rate/latency spike
